currentObjective: Implement deterministic intraprocedural Roslyn complexity extraction
decisions: Phase 3 is specified as an intraprocedural transformation from method C# syntax plus SemanticModel to the Phase 2 ComplexityExpression model.
Extraction responsibilities should be separated across method extraction, method-local semantic context, input-size resolution, basic-operation classification, and loop-bound analysis.
Input-size parameters receive deterministic canonical variables such as n, m, k, and p; irrelevant parameters such as bool and enum do not consume canonical names.
Unsupported invocations and unproven loop bounds produce or propagate Unknown instead of being classified as O(1) or O(n).
BCL/LINQ mappings, call graph, recursion, product diagnostics, and Complexity Model changes remain out of scope for Phase 3.
constraints: Do not modify inherited projects outside analyzer/.
Do not create ProjectReference, binary reference, local package dependency, or transitive dependency on inherited projects.

Do not implement BCL mappings, LINQ mappings, call graph analysis, recursion handling, BIG000x, BIG100x, CodeFixProvider, Workspaces, solver, calibration, amortized, parallel, probabilistic, or memory complexity in Phase 3.
Keep BIG9000 unchanged and disabled by default.
Respect CancellationToken and avoid I/O, network access, process execution, and global mutable analyzer state.
validations: Phase 2 completion was verified against current code and Release tests before creating the Phase 3 specification.
